description: D1: the warning post where the Hoarwatch's shelf runs out onto the Rimeglass - shown once as the giant passes it, never after the Frostbound has fallen.
text: The Rimeglass: a tarn of black ice, and kneeling in it a giant frozen into his own winter - the Frostbound. His cold builds on you as rime: it slows you, and full it freezes you fast (a heavy blow shatters it). Fire thaws it. Heavy blows crack the ice; he is the heaviest thing on it.
